facts.fact: Malijet reports the APDP fined Société Aminata Konaté SARL (Bara Mousso) 5 million F CFA for refusing an APDP verification mission, and served it a formal notice for missing mandatory declarations; the article is dated 2025-06-19 and gives no decision date.
The APDP conducted verification missions and imposed a fine and a formal notice on a named company (Malijet, 2025-06-19).
